research_question: Whether each pre-registered model-plus-compact-scaffold system beats the named pick-trader reference under the frozen sota-v3 mechanics.

panel_design.decision_required: Freeze seeds, repeats, model-family size, and an exact sign-flip design that can clear Holm step one before any accepted smoke.

statistical_analysis_plan.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni across the final registered model family
statistical_analysis_plan.ranking_rule: No model tiers or ordinal ranking; only each registered model's predeclared contrast versus pick-trader is supported.
statistical_analysis_plan.blocker: The final model-family size and seed-versus-repeat allocation are not frozen.
